row.notes: In Game_GarageCrewModule_SpawnGarageCrew (0x140388cf0): rdi = [rbp+0xc8], the garage crew scene handle (the scene lookup leaves it null when findScene fails for garagecrew, e.g. an imported track with no garage scenes). The compiler hoists movzx esi,[rdi+0xe0] above the test rdi,rdi at 0x14038ba27, so a null scene faults at 0x14038ba20 (reading 0xe0; 1.7.9 imported Hockenheim Time Trial, rdi=rcx=rbx=0) although the code after the test handles null (je 0x14038baff zeroes ebx/eax). Core sets esi = 0 and continues at site_Game_GarageCrew_SceneTest. Owner review re-career-teams 2026-11-02: own disasm: mov rdi,[rbp+0xc8] at ba19 (7 bytes), movzx esi,[rdi+0xe0] at ba20 (7 bytes), no jump or call in the function lands in ba21..ba26. Faults for rdi=0. Agrees with V8625.

verify.notes: V8625 mov rdi,[rbp+0xc8] at ba19 (7 bytes) so ba20 starts movzx esi,[rdi+0xe0] (7 bytes); only jumps to ba19 (b9d5,ba0d), none targets ba21..ba26 anywhere in 140388cf0..14038c864 ret; faults for rdi=0.
